news.title: AI giants promise publishers new way to block some scraping
news.summary: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic pledged on Friday to give media outlets and other websites a single way to prevent their content from being scraped to train artificial intelligence (AI) models, amid growing criticisms and legal battles from news publishers.

news.title: Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
news.summary: Factory released Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness that makes programmatic tool calling the default. On Factory’s own Terminal-Bench 4 runs, Droid scores 65.2% with Claude Opus 5.5 at $4.73 per passed task. news.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
news.summary: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 Rust CLI that gives any AI agent computer use on macOS, Windows and Linux by reading OS accessibility trees and acting on stable refs instead of pixels.
